title: Calibration-Family Overfit: Why Trusted Sabotage Monitors Don't Transfer Across Lineages
abstract: arXiv:2607.06596v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trusted monitoring is a central defense in AI control: a cheaper trusted model scores an untrusted model's actions for sabotage, and the most suspicious are audited or deferred. Such monitors are evaluated against one or two untrusted models, and the accuracy is reported as a property of the monitor. We ask whether it is partly a property of the pairing. We make the untrusted policy family the controlled axis: we fit a monitor on family A's transcripts, apply it to family B, and decompose the cross-family AUROC into how obvious each family's sabotage is, how capable each monitor is, and the residual own-family advantage after both are removed: the interaction. On code-backdoor transcripts the interaction is positive and survives the dominant confounds: +0.172 (95% CI [+0.158, +0.185]) on four open-weight families on a strict leak-free basis, holding across an eight-family matrix spanning four frontier vendors, blatancy-matched

translated_title: 校准族过拟合：为何可信的破坏监测器无法跨血统迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.06596v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：可信监控是AI控制中的核心防御手段：一个更便宜的可信模型对不可信模型的行为进行破坏性评分，最可疑的行为会被审计或延迟处理。这类监测器通常针对一两个不可信模型进行评估，其准确性被报告为监测器的属性。我们探究这是否部分取决于配对关系。我们将不可信策略族设为受控变量：在族A的转录本上拟合监测器，应用于族B，并将跨族AUROC分解为每个族破坏行为的明显程度、每个监测器的能力，以及去除两者后剩余的自身族优势（即交互效应）。在代码后门转录本上，交互效应为正且在主要混淆因素控制下依然显著：在四个开源族上基于严格无泄漏基准，+0.172（95%置信区间[+0.158, +0.185]），在涵盖四个前沿供应商的八族矩阵中保持一致，且匹配了明显性。
tldr: 本文发现可信破坏监测器的性能不仅取决于其自身能力，还显著依赖于与目标不可信模型的配对关系，存在正的跨族交互效应，表明监测器存在“校准族过拟合”现象，无法在不同模型血统间可靠迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that trusted sabotage monitors' performance depends not only on their own capability but significantly on the pairing with the target untrusted model, exhibiting a positive cross-family interaction effect, indicating "calibration-family overfitting" that prevents reliable transfer across model lineages.
